jira.label: Jira / Atlassian
jira.product_group_note: Jira Software product-access group on buffett-dev (site default jira-users-{site}). This is the group seed leavers were invited into (Erin/Ned/Tyrion confirmed via GET /rest/api/3/user/groups). groupId from that same call. remove_product_access prefers groupId over the deprecated groupname query param. A leaver may also hold jira-servicemanagement-users-buffett-dev (JSM product access, a separate product); v1 only removes the one configured group. remove_product_access is tried first (manage:jira-configuration-scoped API token); deactivate_user is a best-effort second attempt that requires org-admin API access, which personal/non-domain-claimed Atlassian sites like this one likely do not have.
